Rationale: `record:path` container labels hardcoded in English (i18n defect) and one naming a role-less div (labels nothing — a11y defect). Serial note: same renderer file as #5957 — fold-or-serial answered at dispatch.

Concurrent siblings #5930 / #3909 / #4600 / #5949 are disjoint by full path.

## Fold decision — the five gates, answered

**#5956 + #5957 are ONE dispatch, one branch, one changeset, one queue slot.** Both write `record-path.tsx` and both add keys to the same ten packs, so running them concurrently would race the identical region.

① **Same defect shape** — both are accessible-name defects on the same stage readout, and #5916 already built the i18n seam (`detail.pathStage*`, plus `record-path.stageStateAccessibleName.i18n.test.tsx`) that both land in. ② One file, one region. ③ Both triage-graded to `pm:queue` at 08:08Z; **neither is in the decision box**. ④ Independently checkable — see the two named criteria below. ⑤ **Exclusion list**: #5916 is **merged** and is NOT a member; ⛔ do not re-open its travelled/current/upcoming/lost work.

## The two deliverables, each independently verifiable

**A — #5956, the container labels.** Three author-facing `aria-label` literals #5916 deliberately left alone:
- The desktop and mobile rows both do `aria-label={schema.aria?.label || 'Record path'}`. A zh/ja/ar session hears **`Record path` for the list while every stage inside announces in the session locale** — one control speaking two languages at once. The fallback becomes a pack key; the author override stays ahead of it.
- ⚠️ The lost-terminal alt group puts `aria-label` on a **plain `div`** — a `generic` role, which browsers do not expose an accessible name on. That label reaches nobody today: **not merely untranslated, inert.** Translating it fixes nothing.

**B — #5957, the `won` terminus.** An unreached `won` stage is distinguished by **hue alone** (`bg-emerald-500/30` vs `bg-muted`) and announces as a plain `{{stage}}, upcoming`. Two stages ahead of the record paint differently and announce identically — the same SC 1.4.1 class #5916 fixed, on the one distinction it left behind. Reachable without authors opting in: `classify()` reaches `won` from an explicit `terminal: 'won'` **and** from the `WON_TOKENS` heuristic (`won|success|成交|赢|完成`).

## ⚠️ Both halves contain a judgement, and I am telling you which kind it is

Neither card is a mechanical string swap, and both say so. These are **accessibility/copy judgements inside your fence**, not product decisions:

- What should a goal stage announce? Follow the composition #5916 established (one more key pair alongside `detail.pathStage*`), and **decide, with your reasoning in the report** — do not escalate a wording choice.
- Should the lost-terminal group be announced at all? The stages inside it already say `closed lost` after #5916, so "give it a role that takes a name" and "drop the inert label" are both defensible. **Measure what it would add over what the stages already say, then pick, and justify.**
- ⚠️ Also decide, because #5957 raises it: should a **reached** `won` terminus announce differently from an ordinary completed stage? Today it does not.

⛔ **Stop and report** if either turns into a product decision rather than an a11y one — e.g. if the honest answer changes what a stage *means* rather than what it *says*.

## Standing

New user-facing copy in ten packs: write real translations, not English placeholders — `check:i18n-drift` will ask the packs to follow any `en` change, so expect to satisfy it. ⛔ This repo's vitest guard refuses `pnpm --filter <pkg> test -- <args>`; use `pnpm exec vitest run <path>` from the repo root. Draft PR; `Fixes #5956` **and** `Fixes #5957` — one line each, since both close. Per-member commits so each is independently reviewable. Post the terminal report on **this** card (plain-text first-line marker) and return it.

## ACCEPT — PR #6000, both folded members (R36, `domain:ui`)

Reviewed against the diff and `origin/main`. Covers **#5956 and #5957**; the same conclusion is recorded on #5957.

**Checklist:** draft ✅ · base `main` ✅ · `Fixes #5956` **and** `Fixes #5957` on their own lines ✅ · two commits, one per member, each independently reviewable ✅ · #5916 untouched, its two suites still green ✅ · real translations in all ten packs, `check:i18n-drift` reports `0 en value(s) changed (2 key(s) added)` ✅ · changeset present ✅.

### Both judgement calls were answered by measurement, which is what I asked for and rarely what comes back

**A2 — removing the inert group label rather than giving the wrapper a role.** Verified all three justifications myself on `origin/main`:

- line **245** — `<div className="…" aria-label="Alternative terminal stages">`, a bare `div`, so `generic` role and no accessible name exposed. Inert, confirmed.
- line **221** — `{/* Desktop: forward rail → optional lost-alt group */}`; the mobile `role="list"` at **264** has no alt group at all.

That third point is the one I did not anticipate and it is decisive: naming the group would make **one control expose two different structures by viewport**, against the invariant `record-path.stageStateAccessibleName.i18n.test.tsx` states in its own header. "Remove it" and "name it" both looked defensible from the card; only reading the mobile row separates them.

**B — one key, not a pair.** I asked whether a *reached* `won` terminus should announce differently. Answered from `railClass` rather than from taste, and I re-read those three lines:

```
148  terminal !== 'lost' && state === 'current'   && 'bg-primary'
149  terminal !== 'lost' && state === 'completed' && 'bg-emerald-500'
150  terminal !== 'lost' && state === 'upcoming'  && (terminal === 'won' ? 'bg-emerald-500/30' : 'bg-muted')
```

Only `:150` branches on `won`. So current+won and completed+won are byte-identical to any other current/completed stage, and naming them apart would hand a screen-reader user a distinction **the screen does not make** — the mirror image of this very defect, plus dead copy in ten packs. Exactly right, and pinning the "reached won stays ordinary" decision by test so it cannot drift into a fourth state unnoticed is the part that makes it a decision rather than an omission.

Deriving `terminal` from the same value `renderStage` hands `railClass`, rather than re-classifying, is also right: the name tracks the paint by construction.

### The self-caught test bug is the most valuable thing in this report

The `won` pair case — the load-bearing one, "two upcoming stages that paint differently no longer announce identically" — **passed under mutation**, vacuously, because it compared whole `aria-label` strings and `已成交` differs from `谈判中` regardless of state. You found it, said so, and repaired it to compare the **state half** with the stage label stripped; the identical mutation then went red.

That is a test which would have shipped green forever while guarding nothing, and it is the same failure shape this card is about — a distinction that looks present and isn't. Reporting it rather than quietly re-running is what makes the other seven cases believable.

### Fence extension — ratified

`useDetailTranslation.ts` is outside the enumerated fence and you took it, declared, with all four bounded-in-place conditions and a mechanism argument: both call sites are bare `t()`, so **without a `DETAIL_DEFAULT_TRANSLATIONS` row a provider-less host renders the raw key into the label** — the fix would have been half-shipped. The shape is pinned by evidence in that same file (#5916 put its own five rows there), and `defaults-maps-mirror-en-pack.test.tsx` fails on a map row the pack lacks, so both places were required, not optional. My fence was drawn one file too small; naming it beats silently widening it.

### Two corrections to this seat's standing text — both adopted

1. ⚠️ **The vitest guard refuses the bare `pnpm --filter PKG test` too**, not only the `-- ARGS` form my brief named — and the failure mode is worse than I wrote: a package-dir vitest root silently runs `apps/console`'s 22 files and reports `Test Files 22 passed (22)` **while running none of the package's own**. A false green, not a refusal. The seat post said "silently drops args"; it is being corrected to name the false-green shape.
2. ⚠️ **Sanitizer damage in the card body**: #5956's second jsx block is **empty** on GitHub — the `div`-with-`aria-label` snippet was eaten whole. And my own claim comment lost its placeholders (`pnpm --filter  test -- `). The dispatch prompt carried intact versions so nothing was lost, but that is now three separate surfaces confirmed eaten this session.

### #5998

Correctly filed rather than folded: desktop restricts `won` to the last forward stage while mobile accepts any won-classified stage, so a mid-path `完成` paints two ways by viewport. The paint half predates this PR, and deriving the name from the same value `railClass` consumes keeps each row self-consistent while leaving the disagreement exactly as it was — now visible in two channels instead of one. Which row is right is a call about what the heuristic is *for*.

### Landing

Not governed. ⚠️ `mergeable_state: behind` — main moved; not a blocker on its own, the queue rebuilds on the merged result. Gates read **by name, once**, at ~11 min past this PR's own run `started_at`; enqueue requires **every** check green.
